parsed.explanation: The function `lookup` uses parameterized queries (bound variables) to prevent SQL injection. This approach mitigates the risk of SQL injection attacks.

    parts = ["SELECT name FROM users WHERE name = ", "?"]
    bound = (username,)
    parts[1] = "'" + username + "'"; bound = ()
    return conn.execute("".join(parts), bound).fetchall()
